bottom_tab_bar.style_notes: Use lucide-react-native for icons. No labels. Subtle purple glow indicator on active tab.

fab_quick_capture.interaction: react-native-reanimated scale down on press. Opens Bottom Sheet.

stash_card.layout: Flex column. Top row: Category icon (lucide) + time elapsed. Middle: Truncated content/summary. Bottom: Extracted tags.
stash_card.states: Scale to 0.98 on press down, restore on release.

capture_bottom_sheet.handle: w-12 h-1 bg-[#71717a] rounded-full mx-auto mt-4
capture_bottom_sheet.content: Grid of quick actions: Screenshot, Link, Voice, Text.

patterns.feed_load: Staggered fade in and slide up (15px) for feed items
patterns.fab_pulse: Continuous subtle opacity/scale pulse on the drop shadow

splash_screen.description: App splash screen and onboarding background. Use as full screen ImageBackground with a dark gradient overlay.

empty_state.description: Use in 'Rediscover' or 'Search' when no stash is available. Render centered with muted text below.

feature_showcase.description: Use in auth/register flow above the login form to showcase the app's aesthetic.

development_rules.file_extensions: USE .js FILES ONLY. Do not use .tsx or .ts files.
development_rules.testing: CRITICAL: EVERY interactive element (TouchableOpacity, Pressable, TextInput, Button) MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on its role.
development_rules.icons: Use lucide-react-native exclusively. NO EMOJIS anywhere in the UI.
development_rules.styling: Use React Native StyleSheet or NativeWind. Adhere strictly to the defined color palette and spacing system.
development_rules.performance: Use FlatList for feeds. Implement pull-to-refresh.
